fields.description: Bulgari Ocean Mansions is a collection of five-bedroom waterfront homes on the northern edge of Jumeira Bay Island. Designed by ACPV Architects Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel, the residences extend towards the sea, with terraces and a private pool. Meraas records this project among its completed handovers.

overview: The two-level original plan places formal living and service rooms below five bedrooms and a family lounge. Its reported built-up area should not be relabelled as plot area or a newly verified as-built measurement.
research.locationNote: On the northern shore of Jumeira Bay Island, Dubai. Property Finder contains an unrelated Business Bay paragraph; the official island location is used.
research.priceNote: No current official numeric price was located. Property Finder mixes an AED 70m historical reference with a selected-availability headline near AED 150m. Neither is adopted as a current project-wide price; a specific resale offer requires its own dated documentation.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports a historical 20% booking / 70% construction / 10% handover structure. No primary Ocean Mansions payment sheet was retrieved. As the developer records handover in 2024, this is not offered as a current off-plan schedule.
research.handoverNote: Meraas’ official homepage lists a handover date of 15 November 2024. Property Finder’s December 2023 reference is an earlier estimate. Unit-specific legal transfer and resale availability remain separate checks.
